subject.title: Show Claude CLI and Desktop sessions across paired computers

question: Should OpenClaw make third-party native coding-session catalogs, beginning with Claude CLI/Desktop, a supported cross-device operator feature?
rationale: The feature commits OpenClaw to remotely exposing sensitive third-party transcript stores and maintaining new plugin, Gateway, paired-node, and native UI contracts; source inspection cannot choose that product and privacy policy.

options.title: Sponsor a generic plugin capability
options.body: Approve a vendor-neutral read-only session-catalog contract and implement Claude support in its owning plugin with explicit authorization and format-version handling.

options.title: Start with Gateway-local browsing
options.body: Support Claude sessions only on the Gateway host until the paired-node privacy and protocol model is proven.

options.title: Decline native transcript catalogs
options.body: Keep third-party persisted-session browsing outside the supported OpenClaw product surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a generic plugin capability
recommendation.body: Approve a vendor-neutral read-only session-catalog contract and implement Claude support in its owning plugin with explicit authorization and format-version handling.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the sibling Codex fleet surface and is the strongest history-backed owner for this product decision.
